title: Web Follower not working
symptom: The LLU Web Follower is not working in Germany for Libre. Abbott changed the URL for German accounts from api-eu.libreview.io to api-de.libreview.io, and the follower cannot pull data while LibreLinkUp works.
cause: The thread suggests that the German server (api-de.libreview.io) is not handled correctly in the country/api endpoint mapping of the Web Follower.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. A workaround mentioned is setting the country of the Libre users to Switzerland, which made it work. The maintainer suggested updating to the latest nightly and toggling proxy support, but these did not resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: Maybe there is something wrong or missing in the country / api endpoint mapping?
